en.s: Otho became Roman emperor on 15 January AD 69, during the Year of the Four Emperors. His reign lasted until 16 April 69. This entry records his accession, not the creation of the office of Roman emperor.

zh.s: 公元69年1月15日，奥托在“四帝之年”成为罗马皇帝，其统治持续至同年4月16日。此条记录奥托即位，并非罗马皇帝这一职位的创立。

en.s: The siege of Nara (南都焼討, Nantō Yakiuchi) alternatively known as the Nanto Arson Campaign in Japan is an event which took place on January 15, 1181 (December 28, 1180 in the Jishō calendar), following Prince Mochihito and Minamoto no Yorimasa's defeat and subsequent death to the Taira clan, after which the Taira forces burnt down the Miidera temple (which had sheltered the anti-Taira forces), before moving on to Nara, where they "set fire to the monastic complexes of Kōfuku-ji and Tōdai-ji."

zh.s: 1181年1月15日，即日本治承四年十二月二十八日，平氏军队火烧奈良，这一事件称“南都烧讨”。此前，以仁王与源赖政败于平氏并相继身亡，平军烧毁曾庇护反平氏势力的三井寺，随后进军奈良，放火焚烧兴福寺及东大寺的寺院建筑群。

en.s: The Battle of Capua was fought between 11–15 January 1348 between the troops of Louis I of Hungary and those of the Kingdom of Naples, in the course of the former's invasion of Naples. The Neapolitan troops, led by Queen Joan's second husband Louis of Taranto, were in the fortified town of Capua.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1348年1月11日至15日，匈牙利国王拉约什一世的军队与那不勒斯王国军队在卡普阿交战，这是匈牙利入侵那不勒斯的一部分。那不勒斯军队由女王乔安娜的第二任丈夫、塔兰托的路易领导，驻守在设防的卡普阿城内。

en.s: The Battle of Sandwich was a naval skirmish off the town of Sandwich on the 15 January 1460 during the Wars of the Roses. In it, Sir John Dynham, Sir John Wenlock, and the Earl of Warwick, Captain of Calais, on the Yorkist side, defeated a Lancastrian fleet and captured several of its ships. Little evidence and few details of the battle survive.

zh.s: 1460年1月15日，玫瑰战争中的一场小规模海战，在桑威奇镇外海展开。约克派的约翰·迪纳姆爵士、约翰·温洛克爵士，以及加来驻军统帅沃里克伯爵，击败兰开斯特派舰队，俘获数艘船只。关于这场战斗，现存证据及细节都很少。

en.s: Elizabeth I was crowned at Westminster Abbey in London on 15 January 1559. The coronation was a separate ceremony from her accession to the English and Irish thrones on 17 November 1558.

zh.s: 1559年1月15日，伊丽莎白一世在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕。这场仪式与她于1558年11月17日继承英格兰和爱尔兰王位，是两个不同的事件。

en.s: The Battle of Zarghan (Persian: نبرد زرگان) was the last battle of Ashraf Hotak's career as a statesman. Having been repeatedly bludgeoned by Nader's army through the Battles of Mehmandoost and Murche-Khort, Ashraf had withdrawn from Isfahan and escaped south to Shiraz to rebuild his army in an ultimately futile attempt to reverse his fortunes.

zh.s: 扎尔甘战役是阿什拉夫·霍塔克政治生涯中的最后一战。此前，他在梅赫曼杜斯特和穆尔切霍尔特两场战役中接连遭纳迪尔军队重创，撤出伊斯法罕后向南逃往设拉子，试图重建军队、扭转局势，但最终未能成功。

en.t: The British Museum opens to the public
en.s: On 15 January 1759, the British Museum opened its first exhibition galleries and a scholars’ reading room at Montagu House in London. The opening to visitors was distinct from the museum’s establishment in 1753.

zh.t: 大英博物馆向公众开放
zh.s: 1759年1月15日，大英博物馆在伦敦蒙塔古府开放首批展厅及供学者使用的阅览室。此次对外开放，与博物馆于1753年成立，是两个不同的节点。

en.s: On January 15, 1777, delegates in what is now Vermont declared independence from competing colonial jurisdictions and land claims. The resulting independent state remained without foreign diplomatic recognition until it joined the United States as Vermont in 1791. The January declaration was not the later admission to the Union.

zh.s: 1777年1月15日，今佛蒙特地区的代表宣布脱离对当地提出管辖及土地要求的殖民地政权，建立独立政体。该政体一直未获外国外交承认，直到1791年以佛蒙特州身份加入美国。1月的独立宣言与后来加入联邦不同。

en.s: The action of 15 January 1782 was a minor naval engagement that occurred near the island of Jamaica during the American Revolutionary War. A Royal Naval frigate, HMS Fox, intercepted and engaged two Spanish merchantmen of the Guipuzcoan Company of Caracas, one of 26 guns and the other of 20. Fox was a 32-gun Active-class fifth-rate frigate commanded by Captain Thomas Windsor from 1781.

zh.s: 1782年1月15日，美国独立战争期间，牙买加岛附近发生一场小规模海战。英国皇家海军护卫舰“狐狸”号截击加拉加斯吉普斯夸纳公司的两艘西班牙商船，它们分别配有26门和20门火炮。“狐狸”号是一艘配备32门炮的“活跃”级五级护卫舰，自1781年起由托马斯·温莎舰长指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Quilon (or Battle of Kollam) was fought on the 15 January 1809 at Cantonment Maidan in Quilon, an important port city and business hub on the south west coat of India. The conflict involved troops of the Indian kingdom of Travancore, led by the then Dewan (prime minister) of Travancore, Velu Thampi Dalawa, and a detachment of the British East India Company under Colonel Chalmers. The battle lasted for only six hours and is closely associated with the social and political history of Kerala.

zh.s: 1809年1月15日，奎隆战役在印度西南海岸重要港口和商业中心奎隆，今科拉姆，的军营广场展开。特拉凡哥尔王国当时的首相韦卢·坦比·达拉瓦率军，与查默斯上校指挥的英国东印度公司分队交战。战斗只持续六小时，却与喀拉拉邦的社会政治历史密切相关。

en.s: The Battle of Pla (15 January 1811) saw an Imperial French column made up of two Italian brigades clash with a Spanish division under the command of Pedro Sarsfield. The Spanish troops held steady and repulsed the attack of the first brigade, then counterattacked and defeated both brigades. The combat occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars. The action was fought near El Pla de Santa Maria, north of Valls, Spain. The Siege of Tortosa ended on 2 January 1811 when the Spanish garrison surrendered to Louis Gabriel Suchet's III Corps.

zh.s: 1811年1月15日，由两个意大利旅组成的法国帝国军纵队，与佩德罗·萨斯菲尔德指挥的西班牙一个师交战。西军稳住阵地，击退第一个旅的进攻，随后反击，击败两个旅。战场位于西班牙瓦尔斯以北的圣玛丽亚德普拉附近。这是拿破仑战争中半岛战争的一部分。此前1月2日，托尔托萨围城战结束，西班牙守军向路易·加布里埃尔·絮歇的第三军投降。

en.s: The Cambodian Conflict of 1812–1813 was a dynastic conflict between the incumbent King Ang Chan II of Cambodia, who had support from the Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty under Emperor Gia Long, and his younger brother Prince Ang Sngoun, who had support from Siam under King Rama II of the Rattanakosin Kingdom, resulting in both the Siamese and the Vietnamese marching armies into Cambodia.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1812年至1813年，柬埔寨国王安赞二世与其弟安斯农亲王发生王位争夺。安赞二世得到嘉隆帝统治下的越南阮朝支持，安斯农则得到拉玛二世统治下的暹罗曼谷王朝支持，最终暹罗和越南均向柬埔寨出兵。

en.s: The capture of USS President was one of many naval actions fought at the end of the War of 1812. The American frigate USS President tried to break out of New York Harbor but was intercepted by a British squadron of four frigates and forced to surrender.

zh.s: 美国总统号被俘事件是1812年战争末期的一次海上交锋。美国护卫舰总统号试图突破纽约港封锁，但被一支由4艘英国护卫舰组成的舰队截住，最终被迫投降。

en.t: Brewster’s optics paper read at the Royal Society
en.s: On 15 January 1818, David Brewster’s paper on the laws of polarisation and double refraction in regularly crystallised bodies was read at the Royal Society. On the same day, Augustin-Jean Fresnel signed a supplement on the effects of reflection on polarised light; that supplement was submitted for witnessing on 19 January. Reading, signing and submission were separate acts.

zh.t: 布儒斯特的光学论文在英国皇家学会宣读
zh.s: 1818年1月15日，戴维·布儒斯特关于规则结晶体偏振与双折射规律的论文，在英国皇家学会宣读。同一天，奥古斯丁-让·菲涅耳签署一份讨论反射对偏振光影响的补充论文，并于1月19日提交见证。宣读、签署与提交是不同的行为。

en.s: On January 15, 1838, a joint United States Navy–Army force led by Lieutenant Levin M. Powell fought Seminoles near the Loxahatchee River in southern Florida. A second battle took place in the same area on January 24 under General Thomas Jesup. This entry records the first battle.

zh.t: 第一次洛克萨哈奇战役
zh.s: 1838年1月15日，美国海军中尉莱文·M.鲍威尔率领一支海陆军联合部队，在佛罗里达南部洛克萨哈奇河附近与塞米诺尔人交战。同月24日，托马斯·杰瑟普将军在同一地区指挥了第二次战斗。此条记录第一次战役。

en.s: The 1858 Encounter Bay colonial by-election was held on 15 January 1858 to elect one of two members for Encounter Bay in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member Benjamin Herschel Babbage resigned on 17 December 1857. Henry Bull Templer Strangways won the by-election with 53 per cent of the vote, although the election had an incredibly low turnout, with only six per cent of registered voters casting a ballot.

zh.s: 1858年1月15日，南澳大利亚州众议院恩康特湾选区举行补选，填补两名议员中的一个空缺。原议员本杰明·赫歇尔·巴贝奇于1857年12月17日辞职。亨利·布尔·坦普勒·斯特兰韦斯以53%的选票获胜，但投票率极低，仅6%的登记选民参与投票。

en.s: The Raid on Godfrey Ranch occurred from January 15–16, 1865 in which a large band of Lakota and Cheyenne warriors attacked an isolated ranch in Colorado owned by Holon Godfrey. The raid was one of the numerous January raids by the Cheyennes and its Indian allies during the Colorado War, which were retaliation for the Sand Creek massacre that happened on November 29, 1864. The Indians first attacked the neighboring American Ranch, in which a white family and some of their workers perished, before setting their sights on Godfrey's ranch nearby.

zh.s: 1865年1月15日至16日，大批拉科塔及夏延战士，袭击科罗拉多州霍隆·戈弗雷拥有的一座偏僻牧场。这是科罗拉多战争中夏延人及其原住民盟友在1月发动的多次袭击之一，用来报复1864年11月29日的沙溪大屠杀。他们先袭击邻近的“美国牧场”，造成一户白人家庭及部分工人死亡，随后把目标转向附近的戈弗雷牧场。

en.s: The Second Battle of Fort Fisher was a successful assault by the Union Army, Navy and Marine Corps against Fort Fisher, south of Wilmington, North Carolina, near the end of the American Civil War in January 1865. Sometimes referred to as the "Gibraltar of the South" and the last major coastal stronghold of the Confederacy, Fort Fisher had tremendous strategic value during the war, providing a port for blockade runners supplying the Army of Northern Virginia.

zh.s: 1865年1月，美国内战接近尾声，联邦陆军、海军及海军陆战队成功进攻北卡罗来纳州威尔明顿以南的费希尔堡。费希尔堡有时被称为“南方的直布罗陀”，是邦联最后一处重要的海岸要塞，具有极高的战略价值：它为突破海上封锁、向北弗吉尼亚军团运送补给的船只提供港口。

en.s: The 1867 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on January 15, 1867. Simon Cameron was elected by the Pennsylvania General Assembly to the United States Senate.

en.t: 1867 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1867 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 15, 1867, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate. Incumbent Senator Ira Harris was not renominated for a second term in office. U.S. Representative Roscoe Conkling was elected to succeed him.

zh.t: 1867年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1867年1月15日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，改选该州第三组席位。现任参议员艾拉·哈里斯未获提名竞选第二任期，联邦众议员罗斯科·康克林当选接替他。

en.s: The Regent's Park skating disaster occurred on 15 January 1867 when 40 people died after the ice broke on the lake in London's Regent's Park, pitching about 200 people into icy water up to 12 ft (3.7 m) deep. Most were rescued by bystanders, but 40 people died either from hypothermia or by drowning. At the time, this catastrophe was considered the worst weather-related accident in British history.

zh.t: 伦敦摄政公园滑冰惨案
zh.s: 1867年1月15日，伦敦摄政公园湖面冰层破裂，约200人落入最深约3.7米的冰水中。大多数人被旁观者救起，但仍有40人因失温或溺水死亡。这场灾难当时被认为是英国历史上最严重的天气相关事故。

en.t: Nast’s A Live Jackass Kicking a Dead Lion published
en.s: Thomas Nast’s cartoon A Live Jackass Kicking a Dead Lion appeared in Harper’s Weekly on January 15, 1870. It used a donkey to represent Northern Democrats. Nast helped popularise the party symbol, but the donkey had already appeared in Democratic political imagery before this cartoon.

zh.t: 纳斯特漫画《活驴踢死狮》发表
zh.s: 1870年1月15日，托马斯·纳斯特的漫画《活驴踢死狮》刊登于《哈珀周刊》，用驴代表美国北方民主党人。纳斯特推动了这一政党象征的普及，但在这幅漫画之前，驴就已出现在民主党的政治图像中。

en.t: The first newspaper in Afrikaans, Die Afrikaanse Patriot, is published in Paarl
en.s: Die Afrikaanse Patriot was the first Afrikaans-language newspaper. The first issue was published in Paarl on 15 January 1876. Initially a monthly magazine, it became a weekly two years later. Even though the first edition had just 50 subscribers, it swiftly drew sharp condemnation for promoting Afrikaans as a literary language, as it was then considered nothing more than a "kitchen" variety of Dutch.

zh.t: 首份南非荷兰语报纸创刊
zh.s: 1876年1月15日，首份南非荷兰语报纸《南非荷兰语爱国者报》在帕尔出版。它最初为月刊，两年后改为周刊。尽管首期只有50名订户，该报仍因推动南非荷兰语成为文学语言而迅速遭到激烈批评；当时有人将这种语言贬称为荷兰语的“厨房变体”。

en.s: The Battle of Miraflores occurred on January 15, 1881 in the Miraflores District of Lima, Peru. It was an important battle during the War of the Pacific that was fought between Chile and the forces of Peru. The Chilean army led by Gen. Manuel Baquedano defeated the army commanded by Nicolás de Piérola guarding the second defensive line of the Peruvian capital city. Two days later, Lima, the capital city of Peru was occupied by Chilean troops. Gen. Baquedano's forces marched into Lima triumphant, while Peru's president and his officers fled into the interior, leaving the country without any government.

zh.s: 1881年1月15日，太平洋战争中的米拉弗洛雷斯战役，在秘鲁首都利马的米拉弗洛雷斯区展开。曼努埃尔·巴克达诺将军率领智利军队，击败尼古拉斯·德·皮埃罗拉指挥、守卫首都第二道防线的秘鲁军队。两天后，智利军占领利马。巴克达诺的部队胜利入城，秘鲁总统及其军官则逃往内陆，使该国一度没有政府。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Empire of Brazil on 15 January 1886 to elect members of the 20th legislature of the Chamber of Deputies. These were the third direct elections held after the Saraiva Law was enacted (Law No. 3,029 of 9 January 1881) The Conservative Party won 103 seats, the Liberal Party won 22, and the Republican Party won none.

zh.s: 1886年1月15日，巴西帝国举行议会选举，选出众议院第20届议员。这是1881年1月9日第3029号《萨赖瓦法》实施后的第三次直接选举。保守党赢得103席，自由党22席，共和党未获席位。

en.s: The 1889 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held in January 1889. en.s: James Naismith’s basketball rules appeared in The Triangle on January 15, 1892. The publication introduced the game developed at the International YMCA Training School in Springfield, Massachusetts. This was a publication milestone, distinct from the invention and first playing of the game.

zh.t: 奈史密斯的篮球规则发表
zh.s: 1892年1月15日，詹姆斯·奈史密斯的篮球规则发表于《三角》杂志，向读者介绍在美国马萨诸塞州斯普林菲尔德国际基督教青年会训练学校创立的篮球运动。这是规则发表的节点，与发明篮球及最初开展比赛的时间不同。

en.s: The January 1894 Calgary municipal election was scheduled for January 15, 1894 to elect a Mayor and nine Councillors to sit on the first Calgary City Council from January 17, 1894 to January 7, 1895. In addition, two members were elected as school trustees.

zh.s: 1894年卡尔加里市政选举定于1月15日举行，选出一名市长及九名议员，组成首届市议会，任期从1894年1月17日至1895年1月7日。另外还选出两名校董。

en.s: The 1902–03 United States Senate elections were held on various dates in various states. As these U.S. Senate elections were prior to the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment in 1913, senators were chosen by state legislatures. Senators were elected over a wide range of time throughout 1902 and 1903, and a seat may have been filled months late or remained vacant due to legislative deadlock.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1902年至1903年，美国各州分别在不同日期举行参议院选举。由于宪法第十七修正案直到1913年才获批准，当时的参议员由州议会选出。各地选举时间分散，若州议会陷入僵局，席位可能延迟数月才补齐，或暂时空缺。

en.s: The 1904 Norwich by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 15 January 1904. The constituency returned two Members of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1904年1月15日，英国诺里奇举行议会补选。该选区采用得票最多者当选的制度，共向英国下议院选出两名议员。

en.s: Local elections were held for provincial and municipal posts throughout the Philippine Archipelago on January 15, 1905. Famous lawyers and doctors including the rich and the wealthy, political families were elected. Manuel L. Quezon and Sergio Osmeña Sr. were elected as the first Filipino provincial governors of Tayabas and Cebu.

zh.s: 1905年1月15日，菲律宾群岛各地举行省级及市镇职位选举。知名律师、医生、富人及政治家族成员当选。曼努埃尔·L.奎松与塞尔希奥·奥斯梅尼亚，分别当选塔亚巴斯和宿务首位菲律宾人省长。

en.t: Founding meeting of Alpha Kappa Alpha
en.s: On January 15, 1908, nine founders held Alpha Kappa Alpha’s first official business meeting in Miner Hall at Howard University in Washington, D.C. The historically African American women’s sorority was later incorporated in 1913, a separate institutional milestone.

zh.t: 阿尔法·卡帕·阿尔法姐妹会创立会议
zh.s: 1908年1月15日，9名创办者在美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区霍华德大学的迈纳堂，举行阿尔法·卡帕·阿尔法姐妹会的首次正式会务会议。这个由非裔美国女性组成的姐妹会后来于1913年注册为法人，这是另一个机构发展节点。

en.s: The Arabic-language Palestinian newspaper Falastin began publication in Jaffa on January 15, 1911, according to the National Library of Israel’s newspaper catalogue. Jaffa was then in Ottoman Palestine. The catalogue’s publication date is distinct from the January 14 founding date given in some accounts and from the earliest digitised issues available online.

zh.s: 根据以色列国家图书馆的报刊目录，阿拉伯文巴勒斯坦报纸《巴勒斯坦报》于1911年1月15日在雅法开始出版。雅法当时属于奥斯曼帝国治下的巴勒斯坦地区。目录记载的出版日期，与部分资料记载的1月14日创办日期，以及目前网上可查的最早数字化报刊日期不同。

en.s: An election to Belfast Corporation took place in 1914 as part of that year's Irish local elections. This would be the last election before the Local Government (Ireland) Act 1919, which would replace the traditional FPTP based ward system with an STV system based on proportional representation. The election saw Unionists continuing their dominance of the council, winning a massive majority of the council's seats.

zh.s: 1914年，贝尔法斯特市议会举行选举，作为当年爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。这是《1919年爱尔兰地方政府法》实施前的最后一次选举；新法将以相对多数制为基础的传统选区制度，改为实行比例代表原则的可转移单票制。此次选举中，统一派继续占据主导地位，赢得市议会绝大多数席位。

en.s: An election for all 24 members of Sligo Corporation took place on 15 January 1919, using the single transferable vote (STV). Urban districts in Ireland held annual elections on 15 January each year under the Local Government (Ireland) Act 1898, using plurality voting to replace a cohort of one-third or one-quarter of their councillors. Those elections for 1915–19 were postponed while the First World War was still in progress. The Sligo election was held under the Sligo Corporation Act of 1918, a private act passed in the UK Parliament under the sponsorship of the Sligo Ratepayers Association (SRA), an alliance of Protestants and businessmen which opposed the actions of the outgoing corporation.

zh.t: 1919年爱尔兰斯莱戈市议会选举
zh.s: 1919年1月15日，斯莱戈采用单记可转移投票制，改选市议会全部24名议员。依据1898年《爱尔兰地方政府法》，爱尔兰市区原本每年1月15日，以相对多数制改选三分之一或四分之一的议员，但1915至1919年的选举因第一次世界大战而延期。本次依照1918年《斯莱戈市政法》举行，该法是由斯莱戈纳税人协会推动英国议会通过的私人法案。协会由新教徒及商人组成，反对即将卸任市议会的做法。

en.s: The Great Molasses Flood, also known as the Boston Molasses Disaster or the Great Boston Molasses Flood, occurred on January 15, 1919, in the North End neighborhood of Boston, Massachusetts, in the United States. A large molasses storage tank burst, and a wave of molasses rushed through the streets at an estimated 35 miles per hour (56 kilometers per hour), killing 21 and injuring 150. The event has entered local folklore, and for decades afterward residents claimed that on hot summer days the area still smelled of molasses.

zh.s: 1919年1月15日，美国马萨诸塞州波士顿北端区的一座大型糖蜜储罐爆裂。糖蜜浪潮以估计每小时35英里、即56公里的速度冲过街道，造成21人死亡、150人受伤。这起事件也称波士顿糖蜜洪灾，后来进入当地民间故事。此后数十年，居民仍声称，炎热夏日里这一带还能闻到糖蜜味。

en.s: A presidential election was held in El Salvador between 13 and 15 January 1919, when Salvadorans elected their next president to serve a four-year term from 1919 to 1923. In the election, Jorge Meléndez defeated Pío Romero Bosque and Arturo Araujo; Provisional president Alfonso Quiñónez Molina was elected as Jorge's vice president.

zh.s: 1919年1月13日至15日，萨尔瓦多举行总统选举，选出任期从1919年至1923年的下届总统。豪尔赫·梅伦德斯击败皮奥·罗梅罗·博斯克及阿图罗·阿劳霍获胜，临时总统阿方索·基尼奥内斯·莫利纳则当选其副总统。

en.s: The Battle of Port-au-Prince, or "la débâcle", took place on January 15, 1920 when Haitian rebels, known as cacos, attacked the capital of Haiti during the Second Caco War and the American occupation of Haiti. At 4:00 a.m., "more than 300" caco rebels, many wearing the stolen uniform of the Haitian gendarmes, commanded by Benoît Batraville, attacked the city. The rebels moved into Port-au-Prince in columns, “with flags and conch horns blowing,” only to be gunned down by Browning Automatic Rifle and machine gun fire. It turns out that the city's garrison of American Marines and Haitian gendarmes were ready for the assault, since a citizen who heard the rebels coming informed the former.

zh.s: 1920年1月15日，第二次卡科战争及美国占领海地期间，被称为“卡科”的海地叛军进攻首都太子港。此战也称“大溃败”。凌晨4时，贝努瓦·巴特拉维尔率领“超过300名”叛军进攻，许多人穿着偷来的海地宪兵制服。他们列队入城，挥舞旗帜、吹响海螺号，却遭到勃朗宁自动步枪及机枪火力扫射。原来，一名听见叛军接近的市民已向美军报信，城内美国海军陆战队及海地宪兵驻军早有准备。

en.s: An election to Londonderry Borough Council took place on Thursday 15 January 1920 as part of that year's Irish local elections. As a result, Unionists lost control over Londonderry borough council, which for the first time passed into the control of the city's Catholic majority. The various Nationalist parties in the city contested the election on a pan-nationalist front, emphasizing the national question of Irish self-government, as well as issues over housing.

zh.s: 1920年1月15日星期四，伦敦德里举行市议会选举，是当年爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。统一派失去议会控制权，该市占人口多数的天主教徒首次掌控市议会。各民族主义政党组成共同阵线参选，强调爱尔兰自治的民族议题及住房问题。

en.s: An election to Dublin Corporation took place on Thursday, 15 January 1920 as part of the 1920 Irish local elections. Dublin was divided into ten borough electoral areas to elect 80 councillors for a five-year term of office on the system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV). Sinn Féin won a slight majority in the council, with 42 seats.

zh.s: 1920年1月15日星期四，都柏林举行市议会选举，是当年爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。全市划分十个市镇选区，采用单记可转移投票的比例代表制，选出80名议员，任期五年。新芬党赢得42席，取得微弱多数。

en.t: First Democratic primary in the 1924 Louisiana governor’s race
en.s: On January 15, 1924, Louisiana held the first of two Democratic primaries in its governor’s race. A runoff followed on February 19. With Republicans having little electoral support at the time, the Democratic primaries were the decisive contests; January 15 was not the runoff or a single combined two-round voting day.

zh.t: 1924年路易斯安那州州长选举民主党首轮初选
zh.s: 1924年1月15日，路易斯安那州举行州长选举的民主党首轮初选，第二轮决选随后于2月19日举行。当时共和党在该州缺乏选民支持，因此民主党初选才是决定州长人选的关键竞争。1月15日既不是第二轮，也不是两轮合并为一天举行。

en.s: The 1934 Nepal–India earthquake or 1934 Bihar–Nepal earthquake was one of the worst earthquakes in India's history. The towns of Munger and Muzaffarpur were completely destroyed. This 8.0 magnitude earthquake occurred on 15 January 1934 at around 2:13 pm IST (08:43 UTC) and caused widespread damage in northern Bihar and in Nepal.

zh.s: 1934年1月15日印度标准时间约14时13分，即协调世界时8时43分，尼泊尔与印度发生8.0级地震，又称比哈尔—尼泊尔地震。这是印度历史上最严重的地震之一，蒙吉尔和穆扎法尔普尔两城被彻底摧毁，北比哈尔及尼泊尔多地遭受广泛破坏。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador between 13 and 15 January 1935. Maximiliano Hernández Martínez was the only candidate and was returned unopposed. No results were posted.

zh.s: 1935年1月13日至15日，萨尔瓦多举行总统选举。马克西米利亚诺·埃尔南德斯·马丁内斯是唯一候选人，因无人竞争而连任。选举结果未公布。

en.s: The Chinese Communist Party held an enlarged Politburo meeting in Zunyi, Guizhou, China, from 15 to 17 January 1935 during the Long March. The conference reviewed military strategy and leadership. This entry marks the opening on January 15; it does not describe the meeting as a formal election of a party chairman.

zh.s: 1935年1月15日至17日，长征期间，中国共产党在贵州遵义召开中央政治局扩大会议，讨论军事战略及领导问题。此条记录1月15日的开幕，不将会议描述为正式选举党的主席。

en.t: Spanish Civil War: Nationalist and Republican forces both withdrew after suffering heavy losses at the Second Battle of the Corunna Road
en.s: The Second Battle of the Corunna Road (Spanish: Batalla de la Carretera de Coruña) was a battle of the Spanish Civil War that took place from 13 December 1936 to 15 January 1937, northwest of Madrid. In December 1936, the Nationalists launched an offensive in order to cut the Corunna Road and isolate Madrid, but a Republican counter-offensive stopped the Nationalist advance.

zh.t: 第二次科鲁尼亚公路战役中双方遭受重创后撤退
zh.s: 1936年12月13日至1937年1月15日，西班牙内战中的第二次科鲁尼亚公路战役在马德里西北部展开。1936年12月，国民军发动攻势，试图切断科鲁尼亚公路、孤立马德里，但共和军的反攻阻止了国民军继续推进。

en.t: The Black Dahlia murder: The dismembered corpse of Elizabeth Short is found in Los Angeles
en.s: Elizabeth Short (July 29, 1924 – c. January 14–15, 1947), posthumously known as the Black Dahlia, was an American woman found murdered in the Leimert Park neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, on January 15, 1947. Her case became highly publicized owing to the gruesome nature of the crime, which included the mutilation and bisection of her corpse.

zh.t: “黑色大丽花”案死者遗体被发现
zh.s: 1947年1月15日，伊丽莎白·肖特的遗体在美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶利默特公园街区被发现。肖特生于1924年7月29日，约于1947年1月14日至15日遇害，身后被称为“黑色大丽花”。凶手残害并切分遗体的手法，使案件受到广泛关注。

en.s: The Tianjin campaign was the epitome of the Pingjin campaign, fought between the nationalists and the communists during the Chinese Civil War in the post-World War II era. The result of the Tianjin campaign helped to determine the outcome of the Pingjin campaign. The original communist plan was to capture Tanggu first to cut off the nationalist escape route via sea and then force the nationalists in Beijing and Tianjin to surrender, in order to save the two historical cities from the destruction of the war.

zh.s: 天津战役是第二次世界大战后中国内战期间，国民党军队与共产党军队交战的平津战役中的关键一战，其结果影响了整个平津战役的结局。共产党军队最初计划先攻占塘沽，切断国民党军队的海上退路，再迫使北平和天津的守军投降，以使这两座历史名城免遭战火破坏。

en.s: On 15 January 1962, Indonesian and Dutch naval forces fought in the Arafura Sea near Etna Bay in western New Guinea. The engagement is also known as the Battle of Vlakke Hoek. It later became the focus of an Indonesian naval remembrance day.

zh.s: 1962年1月15日，印度尼西亚与荷兰海军在西新几内亚埃特纳湾附近的阿拉弗拉海交战。这场战斗又称“弗拉克霍克海战”，后来成为印度尼西亚海军纪念日所纪念的事件。

en.s: 1963 Emperor's Cup Final was the 43rd final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Kobe Oji Stadium in Hyōgo on January 15, 1964. Waseda University won the championship.

zh.s: 1964年1月15日，第43届天皇杯决赛在兵库县神户王子体育场举行，决出1963届赛事冠军。早稻田大学最终夺冠。

en.s: The 1966 Nigerian coup d'état began on January 15, 1966 when mutinous Nigerian soldiers led by Kaduna Nzeogwu assassinated 11 senior Nigerian politicians and two soldiers as well as kidnapping three others. The coup plotters attacked the cities of Kaduna, Ibadan, and Lagos while also blockading the Niger and Benue River within a two-day span of time before the coup plotters were subdued. A senior Army officer, General Johnson Aguiyi-Ironsi then used the coup as a pretext to annex power, ending Nigeria's nascent democracy. It was one of the events that led to the Nigerian Civil War.

zh.s: 1966年1月15日，卡杜纳·恩泽奥古率领的尼日利亚叛变士兵，杀害11名高级政治人物及两名军人，并绑架另外三人，政变由此开始。两天内，政变者进攻卡杜纳、伊巴丹及拉各斯，并封锁尼日尔河与贝努埃河，随后被制服。高级将领约翰逊·阿吉伊-伊龙西继而以政变为借口夺权，终结尼日利亚初生的民主制度。这是后来导致尼日利亚内战的事件之一。

en.s: The first AFL-NFL World Championship Game in professional American football, known retroactively as Super Bowl I and referred to in some contemporaneous reports, including the game's radio broadcast, as the Super Bowl, was played on January 15, 1967 at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in Los Angeles, California. The National Football League (NFL) champion Green Bay Packers defeated the American Football League (AFL) champion Kansas City Chiefs by the score of 35–10. Coming into this game, considerable animosity remained between the AFL and NFL, thus the teams representing the two rival leagues (Kansas City and Green Bay, respectively) felt pressure to win.

zh.s: 1967年1月15日，美式橄榄球史上首场AFL—NFL世界冠军赛，在美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶纪念体育场举行。它后来被称为“第一届超级碗”，当时包括广播在内的部分报道也已使用“超级碗”这一名称。国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）冠军绿湾包装工，以35比10击败美式橄榄球联盟（AFL）冠军堪萨斯城酋长。赛前，两大联盟仍存在强烈敌意，因此双方代表队都承受着必须获胜的压力。

en.s: 1966 Emperor's Cup Final was the 46th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Komazawa Olympic Park Stadium in Tokyo on January 15, 1967. Waseda University won the cup.

en.s: Operation Deckhouse Five was a United States Marine Corps (USMC) and Republic of Vietnam Marine Corps operation that took place from 6–15 January 1967 in the Mekong Delta, during the Vietnam War. "The ten-day sweep," reported the AP from its daily military roundup from Saigon, "proved unproductive."

zh.s: 1967年1月6日至15日，越南战争中的“甲板室五号”行动在湄公河三角洲进行，由美国海军陆战队与越南共和国海军陆战队共同实施。美联社在西贡发出的每日军事综述称，这场为期十天的扫荡“没有取得成效”。

en.s: Soyuz 5 (Russian: Союз 5, Union 5) was a Soyuz mission using the Soyuz 7K-OK spacecraft launched by the Soviet Union on 15 January 1969, which docked with Soyuz 4 in orbit. It was the first docking of two crewed spacecraft of any nation, and the first transfer of crew from one space vehicle to another of any nation, the only time a transfer was accomplished with a space walk – two months before the United States Apollo 9 mission performed the first internal crew transfer.

zh.s: 1969年1月15日，苏联发射联盟5号飞船，使用联盟7K-OK型航天器，随后在轨与联盟4号对接。这是世界上首次两艘载人飞船对接，也是首次将乘员从一艘航天器转移到另一艘，转移通过太空行走完成。两个月后，美国阿波罗9号任务才首次实现舱内乘员转移。

en.s: The Nigerian Civil War (6 July 1967 – 15 January 1970), also known as the Biafran War, Nigeria–Biafra War, or Biafra War, was an armed conflict fought between Nigeria and the Republic of Biafra, a secessionist state that had declared its independence from Nigeria in 1967. During the war years, General Yakubu Gowon served as the head of state of Nigeria, while Biafra was led by Lieutenant Colonel Chukwuemeka "Emeka" Odumegwu Ojukwu.

zh.s: 1974年1月15日，巴西通过选举人团举行间接总统选举。这是军事政府时期的第四次总统选举。

en.s: The Alvor Agreement, signed on 15 January 1975 in Alvor, Portugal, granted Angola independence from Portugal on 11 November and formally ended the 13-year-long Angolan War of Independence. The agreement was signed by the Portuguese government, the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA), the National Liberation Front of Angola (FNLA), National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA), and it established a transitional government composed of representatives of those four parties.

zh.s: 1975年1月15日，葡萄牙政府、安哥拉人民解放运动、安哥拉民族解放阵线，以及争取安哥拉彻底独立全国联盟，在葡萄牙阿尔沃尔签署协议，规定安哥拉于11月11日脱离葡萄牙独立，正式结束长达13年的安哥拉独立战争。协议建立了由上述四方代表组成的过渡政府。

en.s: Linjeflyg Flight 618 was a crash of a Vickers 838 Viscount during approach to Stockholm Bromma Airport at 09:05 on 15 January 1977. All twenty-two people on board the aircraft perished when it hit ground at Kälvesta in Stockholm, Sweden. The domestic service from Malmö via Kristianstad, Växjö and Jönköping was operated by Skyline on behalf of Linjeflyg as part of the latter's domestic scheduled services.

en.s: General elections were held in Burma between 1 and 15 January 1978. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Burma Socialist Programme Party as the sole legal party. It therefore won all 464 seats in People's Assembly. Voter turnout was reported to be 93.3%.

en.s: The 1985 Brazilian presidential election was the last to be held indirectly through an electoral college, and the last to be held under the Military Regime. The electoral college system was put in place so that the military elite that controlled the government could secure the election of the candidate chosen by the High Command of the Armed Forces as President. However, in 1985, due to the process of negotiated transition to democracy that started in the late 1970's, the politicians in the electoral college were placed under no coercion, and were allowed to choose the president of their choice.

zh.s: 1985年巴西总统选举，是最后一次通过选举人团间接选举总统，也是军事政权时期的最后一次总统选举。选举人团制度原本用来确保掌权的军方精英，能够让武装部队最高统帅部选中的人出任总统。但随着20世纪70年代末开始的民主化协商过渡，1985年选举人团内的政治人物没有受到胁迫，可以自由选择支持的总统人选。

en.s: Royal Rumble (1989) was the second annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), and the first to be held on pay-per-view. It took place on January 15, 1989, at The Summit in Houston, Texas. The main event was the 1989 Royal Rumble match won by Big John Studd, who last eliminated Ted DiBiase to win the match. Featured matches on the undercard were Jim Duggan and The Hart Foundation (Bret Hart and Jim Neidhart) versus Dino Bravo and The Fabulous Rougeaus (Jacques and Raymond Rougeau), Rockin' Robin versus Judy Martin for the WWF Women's Championship and King Haku versus Harley Race.

zh.s: 1989年1月15日，世界摔角联盟（WWF）在美国得克萨斯州休斯敦的The Summit举办第二届年度“皇家大战”，首次采用按次付费形式。压轴皇家大战中，大约翰·斯塔德最后淘汰泰德·迪比亚兹，取得胜利。其他重点对决包括：吉姆·达根与哈特基金会组合布雷特·哈特、吉姆·奈德哈特，对阵迪诺·布拉沃及鲁乔兄弟雅克、雷蒙；罗金·罗宾与朱迪·马丁争夺WWF女子冠军；以及King Haku对阵哈利·雷斯。

en.s: On 15 January 1991, Elizabeth II, acting as Queen of Australia, signed letters patent creating the Victoria Cross for Australia on the advice of Prime Minister Bob Hawke. This entry records the establishment of an Australian honour, not a presentation of the medal to a recipient.

zh.t: 澳大利亚维多利亚十字勋章设立
zh.s: 1991年1月15日，伊丽莎白二世以澳大利亚女王身份，根据总理鲍勃·霍克的建议签署英皇制诰，设立澳大利亚维多利亚十字勋章。此条记录的是澳大利亚设立该项荣誉，并非向某位获奖者颁授勋章。

en.s: Operation Enduring Freedom – Philippines (OEF-P) or Operation Freedom Eagle was part of Operation Enduring Freedom and the global war on terror. The Operation targeted the various Jihadist terror groups operating in the country. By 2009, about 600 U.S. military personnel were advising and assisting the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) in the Southern Philippines.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 菲律宾“持久自由”行动又称“自由之鹰”行动，是美国“持久自由”行动及全球反恐战争的一部分，目标是菲律宾境内的各类圣战主义恐怖组织。到2009年，约有600名美军人员在菲律宾南部为菲律宾武装部队提供顾问和协助。

en.s: On January 15, 2005, Russian security forces carried out two raids on Islamist militants’ safehouses in Dagestan. The operations resulted in deaths among both security personnel and militants. This entry records the raids rather than attributing other earlier attacks to the group as an established fact.

zh.s: 2005年1月15日，俄罗斯安全部队在达吉斯坦对伊斯兰主义武装人员的藏身处发动两次突袭。安全人员与武装人员均有伤亡。此条记录当天的突袭，不将其他更早的袭击一概认定为该组织所为。

en.s: KSW III: Konfrontacja was a mixed martial arts event held on January 15, 2005, in Warsaw, Poland. It was a specific event in the KSW programme, not the entire 2005 season.

en.s: The Democratic Progressive Party chairmanship by-election of 2006 was held on January 15, 2006 in Taiwan. It was the tenth chairmanship election conducted by the party. In December 2005, chairperson Su Tseng-chang resigned as a result of failing to win ten of the twenty-three positions in the 2005 local elections.

zh.s: 2006年1月15日，台湾民进党举行主席补选，是该党第十次主席选举。2005年地方选举中，民进党未能达成在23个职位中赢得十个的目标，主席苏贞昌因此于同年12月辞职。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Finland on 15 and 29 January 2006 which resulted in the re-election of Tarja Halonen as President of Finland for a second six-year term. The first round of voting in Finnish presidential elections always takes place on the third Sunday of January, in this case 15 January 2006.

en.s: A general election was held in Barbados on 15 January 2008. A concurrent referendum to determine whether or not to become a republic was initially planned but that vote was postponed. The Democratic Labour Party (DLP), which had been in opposition since 1994, won with 20 seats to 10 seats for the Barbados Labour Party, led by Prime Minister Owen Arthur. Recounts were held in some constituencies due to close results. On 11 September 2008 Hamilton Lashley MP, for St. Michael South-East announced he would cross the floor and no longer be a member of the Barbados Labour Party, but would instead become an independent.

zh.s: 2008年1月15日，巴巴多斯举行大选。原计划同时就是否改为共和国举行公投，但公投延期。自1994年以来一直在野的民主工党赢得20席，击败欧文·阿瑟总理领导、取得十席的巴巴多斯工党。部分选区因结果接近而重新计票。9月11日，圣迈克尔东南选区议员汉密尔顿·拉什利宣布退出巴巴多斯工党，改为独立议员。

en.s: The 2008 Michigan Republican presidential primary took place on January 15, 2008. Mitt Romney came in first with 39 percent of the vote, followed by John McCain with 30 percent and Mike Huckabee in third-place with 16 percent. The victory was widely viewed as critical for the Romney campaign, as a loss in Michigan, where his father was governor, would have resulted in a loss of momentum after two losses already in New Hampshire and Iowa.

zh.t: 2008年美国共和党密歇根州总统初选
zh.s: 2008年1月15日，共和党在密歇根州举行总统初选。米特·罗姆尼以39%的得票率居首，约翰·麦凯恩以30%居次，迈克·赫卡比以16%位列第三。罗姆尼此前已在新罕布什尔和艾奥瓦两地失利，如果在父亲曾任州长的密歇根再败，将进一步失去竞选势头，因此这场胜利被普遍认为对他至关重要。

en.s: The 2008 Michigan Democratic presidential primary took place January 15, 2008. Originally, the state had 156 delegates up for grabs that were to be awarded in the following way: 83 delegates were to be awarded based on the winner in each of Michigan's 15 congressional districts while an additional 45 delegates were to be awarded to the statewide winner.

zh.t: 2008年美国民主党密歇根州总统初选
zh.s: 2008年1月15日，民主党在密歇根州举行总统初选。该州原有156个代表名额可供争夺，原定分配方式包括：按全州15个国会选区各自的胜出者分配83席，另按全州胜出者分配45席。

en.s: US Airways Flight 1549 was a regularly scheduled US Airways domestic flight from New York City's LaGuardia Airport to Charlotte and Seattle, that ditched onto the Hudson River shortly after takeoff on January 15, 2009, due to a double engine failure caused by a bird strike. The Airbus A320 operating the flight, registered N106US, struck a flock of Canada geese shortly after takeoff from LaGuardia, resulting in a dual engine failure.

zh.t: 全美航空1549号班机在哈德孙河迫降
zh.s: 2009年1月15日，全美航空1549号国内定期班机由纽约拉瓜迪亚机场飞往夏洛特和西雅图。执飞的空中客车A320注册号为N106US，起飞后不久撞上一群加拿大雁，导致双发动机失效，随后在哈德孙河水上迫降。

en.s: The Chinese dating programme Fei Cheng Wu Rao, known in English as If You Are the One, was first broadcast on January 15, 2010. Produced by Jiangsu Television and recorded in Nanjing, the programme was hosted by Meng Fei and loosely based on the Taken Out format.

zh.s: 2010年1月15日，中国相亲节目《非诚勿扰》首次播出。节目由江苏卫视制作，在南京录制，由孟非主持，并借鉴了《Taken Out》的节目模式。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Kazakhstan on 15 January 2012. The result was a victory for the Nur Otan party, which won 83 of the 98 seats in the Mäjilis. However, the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) stated that the election "did not meet fundamental principles of democratic elections." The elections marked the first time that the second-placed party would gain parliamentary seats irrespective of whether it cleared the 7% electoral threshold.

zh.s: 2012年1月15日，哈萨克斯坦举行议会选举，“祖国之光”党赢得马日利斯98个席位中的83席。欧洲安全与合作组织认为，选举“未达到民主选举的基本原则”。此次选举首次规定，得票第二多的政党无论是否跨过7%的得票门槛，都能取得议会席位。

en.s: The Badrashin railway accident took place near Badrashin station in Giza, Egypt, on 15 January 2013. A train en route to Cairo from Sohag derailed, leaving at least 19 people dead and 120 injured. Egyptian President Mohammed Morsi visited victims of the crash on 15 January, pledging to hold those responsible to account. Meanwhile, witnesses said the last carriage of the train jumped the tracks and crashed into another train parked nearby.

zh.s: 2013年1月15日，一列从索哈杰驶往开罗的火车在埃及吉萨的巴德拉欣车站附近脱轨，造成至少19人死亡、120人受伤。总统穆罕默德·穆尔西当天探望伤者，并承诺追究责任。目击者称，列车最后一节车厢脱轨，撞上附近停放的另一列火车。

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜35：罗克霍尔德对阵菲利普

en.s: The El Junquito raid (codenamed Operation Gideon) was a police and military raid that occurred on 15 January 2018 in El Junquito, Capital District, Venezuela, which resulted in the death of rebel Óscar Alberto Pérez and members of his movement.

en.t: DusitD2 complex attack begins in Nairobi
en.s: On January 15, 2019, a coordinated attack began at the DusitD2 complex in Nairobi, Kenya. A suicide bombing was followed by gunfire from other attackers associated with Al-Shabaab. The attack continued into January 16. This entry records its opening day.

zh.t: 内罗毕杜西特D2园区袭击开始
zh.s: 2019年1月15日，肯尼亚内罗毕的杜西特D2园区遭到协同袭击。自杀式炸弹爆炸后，与青年党有关的其他袭击者开枪射击。袭击持续到1月16日，此条记录的是袭击开始的日期。

en.t: Commons rejects Theresa May’s Brexit agreement
en.s: On 15 January 2019, the United Kingdom House of Commons rejected Theresa May’s proposed European Union withdrawal agreement by 432 votes to 202, a margin of 230. The vote concerned the agreement; it did not itself remove the government from office.

zh.t: 英国下议院否决特雷莎·梅的脱欧协议
zh.s: 2019年1月15日，英国下议院以432票反对、202票赞成，否决特雷莎·梅提出的退出欧盟协议，票差达230票。此次表决针对脱欧协议，本身并不意味着政府被罢免。

en.s: A moment magnitude (Mw) 6.2 earthquake struck Majene Regency in West Sulawesi, Indonesia, on 15 January 2021, at 02:28 WITA (18:28 UTC). The reverse faulting shock initiated at 18.0 km (11.2 mi) depth with an epicenter inland, located 32 km (20 mi) south of Mamuju. It was preceded by a Mw 5.7 foreshock several hours prior.

zh.s: 2021年1月15日印度尼西亚中部时间02时28分，即世界协调时1月14日18时28分，印尼西苏拉威西省马杰内县发生矩震级6.2级地震。地震为逆断层型，震源深度18公里，震中位于马穆朱以南32公里的内陆地区。数小时前，当地曾发生矩震级5.7级前震。

en.t: 2022 Hunga Tonga–Hunga Haʻapai eruption and tsunami
en.s: In December 2021, an eruption began on Hunga Tonga–Hunga Haʻapai, a submarine volcano in the Tongan archipelago in the southern Pacific Ocean. The eruption reached a very large and powerful climax nearly four weeks later, on 15 January 2022. Hunga Tonga–Hunga Haʻapai is 65 kilometres (40 mi) north of Tongatapu, the country's main island, and is part of the highly active Tonga–Kermadec Islands volcanic arc, a subduction zone extending from New Zealand to Fiji.

zh.t: 洪阿汤加—洪阿哈阿帕伊火山剧烈喷发及海啸
zh.s: 2021年12月，南太平洋汤加群岛的洪阿汤加—洪阿哈阿帕伊海底火山开始喷发，近四周后于2022年1月15日达到极其猛烈的高峰。火山位于汤加主岛汤加塔布以北65公里，属于高度活跃的汤加—克马德克火山弧；这条俯冲带从新西兰延伸至斐济。

en.s: Yeti Airlines Flight 691 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight flown by Yeti Airlines from Kathmandu to Pokhara in Nepal. On 15 January 2023, the ATR 72 being operated on the route stalled and crashed while landing at Pokhara, killing all 68 passengers and 4 crew members on board. The investigation revealed that Captain Kamal KC had accidentally feathered the engines, causing a loss of thrust.

zh.s: 雪人航空691号班机是从尼泊尔加德满都飞往博卡拉的定期国内客运航班。2023年1月15日，执飞的ATR 72在博卡拉降落时失速坠毁，机上68名乘客及四名机组人员全部遇难。调查发现，机长卡迈勒·KC误将螺旋桨置于顺桨状态，导致推力丧失。

en.s: The 2023 Supercopa de España final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2023 Supercopa de España, the 39th edition of the annual Spanish football super cup competition. The match was played on 15 January 2023 at the King Fahd International Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

en.s: The 2023 Supercopa de Chile (known as the Supercopa Easy 2023 for sponsorship purposes) was the eleventh edition of the Supercopa de Chile, competition organised by the Asociación Nacional de Fútbol Profesional (ANFP). The match was played by the 2022 Chilean Primera División champions Colo-Colo and the 2022 Copa Chile champions Magallanes on 15 January 2023 at Estadio Sausalito in Viña del Mar.

en.s: The 2024 Iowa Libertarian presidential caucuses were held on January 15, 2024, as part of the 2024 Libertarian primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 2022 U.S. Senate candidate Chase Oliver from Georgia won the non-binding preferential vote with 42.7% of the vote, however, he only received 38 votes.

en.s: The 2024 Iowa Republican presidential caucuses were held on January 15, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 40 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a proportional basis. As in past primary cycles, the Iowa caucuses were the first-in-the-nation Republican presidential nominating contest.
